body:
#

Hello,
It’s Scott Kelly — Mark Kelly’s twin brother (also an astronaut!).
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q22026.A9rDp6&refcode=em260628-1-b&refcode2=11577.3935704.V6iwLS&t=1&akid=11577%2E3935704%2EV6iwLS)_(I’m the one on the left.)_
I know Mark and Gabby pretty well, better than most. To know them is to know one thing: **_Don’t ever — not even for one moment — underestimate them._**
On January 8, 2011, I was commanding the International Space Station (ISS) when Gabby was shot at a constituent event. It rocked our family forever.
Throughout the next few weeks, I called Mark every day on the phone as he updated me on Gabby’s condition. I traveled to see them immediately after landing.
I am in awe of Gabby. It’s now been fifteen years since that terrible day, but Gabby hasn’t stopped fighting — not only for herself, but for our families across the country.
But the truth is, not everybody likes that. That’s exactly why the NRA is working so hard to attack Gabby and the incredible work she’s accomplished at GIFFORDS.
It’s never easy watching your family get attacked, but I’m so grateful to know you have their back. Together, you have helped them stand up to the gun lobby and pass more than 820 gun safety laws. That’s no small feat.
**But as the attacks ramp up ahead of the midterm elections, Gabby can’t win this fight alone. So I have an important request:**
**[Will you please chip in $3 to stand with Gabby? GIFFORDS PAC is working to reach undecided voters and take on the gun lobby’s influence in our politics, but she needs your help before her critical end-of-quarter deadline.](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q22026.A9rDp6&refcode=em260628-1-b&t=2&akid=11577%2E3935704%2EV6iwLS)**

I don’t reach out often, so when I do, I hope you know it’s important. Thank you in advance for supporting Gabby in this fight.
Thank you,
Scott Kelly

**Please, take a second to read this...**
GIFFORDS has been on the front lines to save lives from gun violence for more than a decade, but we can’t do it alone.
If everyone reading this donated just $17, we'd have the resources to pass commonsense gun safety legislation across the country. But not everyone gives — making it even more important for people who care and understand the stakes of our struggle to pitch in what they can.
**If $17 seems worth it to you to change our gun laws in order to make our communities safer from gun violence, we are asking you to stand with Gabby Giffords and donate today.**

name: Tim Kaine
subject: This should alarm every American
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026]
Derek, the Trump administration has spent months laying the groundwork to interfere in this year's midterm elections — and their latest move should alarm every American:
Without any explanation, the Department of Justice removed its Federal Prosecution of Election Offenses manual from its website. This manual has governed how the DOJ handles election crimes for decades, under both Republican and Democratic administrations, and it makes clear the federal government has no business interfering with elections for partisan purposes.
This manual is a critical safeguard in our election process, and removing it paves the way for politically motivated legal actions ahead of the midterm elections.
Trump and his administration are not hiding their intentions anymore. He’s already threatened to “take over the voting process” in at least 15 places across the country — threatening to use federal power to interfere in elections run by states and local communities.
His DOJ has sued 30 states for access to their voter rolls, made unprecedented demands for ballots and election equipment, and pushed debunked claims of widespread noncitizen voting.
They've gutted the DOJ’s Public Integrity Section — which was created after Watergate to investigate and prosecute federal crimes affecting our government — reducing the staff from 36 attorneys down to just two.
And they installed a former Republican congressman as the department's chief election fraud prosecutor to help pursue Trump's discredited claims.
Remember, the Constitution was a creation of the state governments in 1787. It makes clear that we are not a system where the states are subordinates or pawns of the federal government. Elections are run by the states, and efforts by the federal government to swoop in and take over that process would likely result in voter suppression across the country, especially in this year’s midterms.
Along with Mark Warner and 22 Senate colleagues, we’re demanding answers from Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche. But we also need the public to know what's happening here and to speak out.
This administration is doing everything it can to rig the midterm elections in its favor, and we cannot let them get away with it. If you agree that Trump can’t interfere in the election process, please click here or the button below to sign your name and let me know where you stand. ADD YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/a8jyrdTLREqZ4Vat1U7Kkw2]
Free and fair elections are non-negotiable. I'll keep fighting to make sure they stay that way.
—Tim

Hi Peter,
Your inbox is probably filling up with emails right now from campaigns like this one, talking about a big impending deadline and asking you to donate right now.
That’s because this Tuesday, June 30th, is the end of the quarter and a big FEC deadline – which means every federal candidate is required to file a public campaign finance report showing all the money they’ve raised over the last three months.
These reports are critical for campaigns because once they’re public, anyone can read them – like our Republican opponents, journalists and political commentators, and even national GOP groups looking for key races to pour money into and help solidify their hold on power.
Strong numbers tell a clear story: Kelly has deep grassroots support, a campaign built from the ground up, and the resources to win in November. A story like that can lead to more support from allies and more momentum while deterring outside money from flooding into our opponents' pockets.
Weak numbers signal the opposite – creating doubt for people who may have been sitting on the fence, and opening up space for our opponents to push even harder and pour more money into the race.
But here’s why this matters so much for our campaign: Kelly doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists. She’s funded by the grassroots, which means every dollar in our report comes from people like you, giving a few dollars at a time.
We’re chipping away at our $40K online goal, but we’re not there yet. Can you help us close the gap by making a contribution before midnight on June 30th? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-em-26]

That’s because this Tuesday, June 30th, is the end of the quarter and a big FEC deadline – which means every federal candidate is required to file a public campaign finance report showing all the money they’ve raised over the last three months. These reports are critical for campaigns because once they’re public, anyone can read them – like our Republican opponents, journalists and political commentators, and even national GOP groups looking for key races to pour money into and help solidify their hold on power. Strong numbers tell a clear story: Kelly has deep grassroots support, a campaign built from the ground up, and the resources to win in November. A story like that can lead to more support from allies and more momentum while deterring outside money from flooding into our opponents' pockets. Weak numbers signal the opposite – creating doubt for people who may have been sitting on the fence, and opening up space for our opponents to push even harder and pour more money into the race. But here’s why this matters so much for our campaign: Kelly doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists. Hello,
I’ll get right to it: **I’m emailing to ask you to help me defeat Lauren Boebert by making a donation right now to my campaign.**
At midnight on Tuesday, our campaign will be facing our first FEC deadline of the General Election. You’ve probably heard about these “FEC deadlines” before – and it’s for a good reason.
After June 30, our campaign is required by federal law to publicly report our fundraising totals. Everyone will scour that report. Journalists will report how much we’ve raised. The national party will take notice. Lauren Boebert will see the strength of the grassroots campaign we’ve been building. And the Super PACs will be watching, ready to pounce at any shred of weakness.
This FEC deadline isn’t just about meeting a goal to fund our campaign. It will show the world whether or not we are prepared to take on Lauren Boebert – and defend our very democracy and constitution.
Adam Frisch only lost to Lauren Boebert by 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. **We can finally defeat Lauren Boebert, but right now, we’re still short of our $250,000 FEC goal, and I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to finally send Boebert packing.**

**Good news, friend.**
Another court just rejected Donald Trump's attempt to take control of America's elections.
A federal judge blocked key parts of Trump's executive order that would have allowed the federal government to pressure states into handing over voter data, create a national voter registration database, and interfere with mail voting.
The judge's message was simple:
_"The Constitution does not grant the President any specific powers over elections."_
This is another major victory for Democratic Secretaries of State who have spent months fighting Trump's attempts to seize more control over state-run elections.
**But this fight is far from over. **
As soon as Monday, the Supreme Court is expected to issue a major ruling that could dramatically reshape mail-in voting across the country. This win is important, but could be short-lived.
**That’s why _we can’t let our guard down now_** , and why DASS is working to make sure that we elect Democratic Secretaries of State who will defend voting rights no matter what comes from the Supreme Court or the Trump administration.

body:

subject: Wisconsin Families Deserve Better
body:
When I think about why I am running for State Treasurer, I think about my family.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c6be55c1b224/c2y1sg9w12-10123129?e=f59034ca3e)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/K7esXgUb6BB?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,
When I think about why I am running for State Treasurer, I think about my family.I grew up in a small rural Wisconsin community in Black Earth, surrounded by farmers, teachers, nurses, and small business owners. People who worked hard, took care of each other, and always showed up for their communities.

---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/V_MxebdIf_D?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |

Too often, our government systems aren’t working the way they should for families across the state. Government systems feel confusing and out of reach, especially when it comes to taxes and how tax dollars are spent. I’ve seen that firsthand in my work in local government and public service, and I’m running to help change that.
Government should be something people can actually understand and trust – especially when it comes to things like taxes, schools, and how public money gets used. Right now, too many families are left trying to figure it out on their own.
I’m running because I believe Wisconsin families deserve better. I was raised by parents who taught me we’re meant to show up for one another, and that’s something that has guided me ever since.

---

clean_body: When I think about why I am running for State Treasurer, I think about my family. | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi Peter, When I think about why I am running for State Treasurer, I think about my family.I grew up in a small rural Wisconsin community in Black Earth, surrounded by farmers, teachers, nurses, and small business owners. People who worked hard, took care of each other, and always showed up for their communities. | | Too often, our government systems aren’t working the way they should for families across the state. Government systems feel confusing and out of reach, especially when it comes to taxes and how tax dollars are spent. I’ve seen that firsthand in my work in local government and public service, and I’m running to help change that. Government should be something people can actually understand and trust – especially when it comes to things like taxes, schools, and how public money gets used. Right now, too many families are left trying to figure it out on their own. I’m running because I believe Wisconsin families deserve better. I was raised by parents who taught me we’re meant to show up for one another, and that’s something that has guided me ever since. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | We’re in an important stretch of this campaign with our fundraising deadline on June 30, and we need your help to keep this message reaching people across Wisconsin. “When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.”- Isaiah 59:19
| You're probably just as versed as I am, but there's no hiding we're amidst a real spiritual battle these days. No, this isn't a joke or some game.
The actual soul of our nation is on the line.
I read and reflected on Isaiah 59:19 the other day. I thought you should see it. The passage reads:

"When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him." -Isaiah 59:19
It's unfortunate how prevalent sick and godless ideology is in our society today. It's taken root and seems to be growing faster than ever. Coastal elites and liberal billionaires alike have bankrolled monsters in their scheme to take the House Majority and do their best to thrust our country into utter chaos.
My team and I are doing everything we possibly can... fighting to defend the House majority from these lunatics.
But if we fail in Congress, our nation will quickly fall to this insidious evil, too. This much is clear.
Listen, I'm not going to tell you this will be a walk in the park. We have a ton of work to do. Protecting our Christian way of life, our children, and our shared values is an incredibly tall order. But this short excerpt from Isaiah reminded me that with the Lord on our side, we shall overcome all that stands against us!
From being a Navy SEAL to husband and father, no matter the role, I have always led with the light of Christ, and that's not about to change as we defend the House this coming November. But I can't win this race alone. I need your prayers and support.
Now, from the bottom of my heart, I'm personally asking you to please remember my team and me in your daily prayers, and if you can, chip in a few bucks to help us win this CRUCIAL race.

clean_body: The one thing Trump will never overpower. | Every time we turn on the news, there’s another attack on our democracy, our planet, or basic human decency — and that’s no accident. No matter how many headlines he generates, there’s one thing he can’t touch — the power of grassroots organizing. Now he faces David Valadao, one of the most vulnerable Republicans in the country, in a race that could help flip the House. 🌍 In Texas — the top oil-producing state in the nation — Christian Menefee won his runoff to become the Democratic nominee for TX-18, a historic seat once held by Barbara Jordan and Sheila Jackson Lee. 🌍 In Arizona, our Clean Energy Slate took on Turning Point — one of the best-funded far-right groups in the country — and won 11 of 13 races for the Salt River Project Board. For the first time in history, clean energy candidates hold the majority on the board of one of the largest public utilities in America. 🌍 And in Oregon, Myrna Muñoz unseated a corporate-backed incumbent in the most expensive legislative race in state history — proof that relentless organizing beats fossil fuel money every time. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. clean_body: The Supreme Court has ruled on one of three cases we’re watching closely. | | Peter, This week, the Supreme Court ruled on one of three major cases we have been watching closely. The first ruling is a disaster for anyone who wants to feel safe from gun violence in public spaces like concerts, grocery stores, and hotels. The Court stood with the gun lobby to strike down a Hawaii gun law keeping guns from publicly accessible spaces unless explicitly permitted. The remaining cases have just as much capacity for catastrophe. One could uphold bans on trans children playing sports with their friends. It would entrench discrimination against an extremely small and vulnerable population as a nationwide value. The other could let wealthy donors pour even more money into influencing our elections. That would allow extremist elites to continue warping our system against us. The fact that these decisions are options for the Roberts Court is a barefaced condemnation of their legitimacy. With a matter of days left in their month of rulings, now is the time for maximum pressure. The corrupt, captured Supreme Court has attacked basic human rights time and time again. If they can strip away reproductive rights without a second thought, they’ll be chomping at the bit to side with extremist hate against a handful of trans kids. And when it comes to campaign finance, the Court has long been authors of their own corruption. Citizens United opened the floodgates for the political spending that placed the extremists in power who packed the Court full of loyalists. Multiple justices have been caught glad-handing with Wall Street billionaires. Now they’re poised to break down more of our democracy and silence more of our voices on behalf of their wealthy backers. This is crunch time. They only have a few days left to hand down rulings on these cases, and we only have a few days left to put as much pressure as we can on the justices and on Congress to hold them accountable. We’re building the people power to take on the extremists who have rigged the system against us. And when the Court does rule, we’ll be there to fight back. I’m running for Congress to fire serial grifter Rob Bresnahan. I’m going to ask you to [**chip in before our end-of-quarter deadline,**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134192785/630422163/1139927205?amount=10&refcode=6.28.26_og_fr_eoq1bio&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODY2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMWZiZWM4My0wYzczLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XIfuzxbl0dr0_lJmiLFMIqpOx7zT4cKLRsQ1qxyYXLM=) but first I want to tell you about myself and why this race is so crucial. I ran for mayor of Scranton to clean up corruption and make government work for our neighbors. These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas

✅ Indiana
✅ Montana

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

clean_body: I wanted you to see this firsthand | | | | | Patriot, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. name: Nico, United We Dream
subject: 14 years of DACA, and the fiercest fight yet
body:
14 years of DACA, and its protections have never been under greater threat. Chip in to UWD today. | | | Peter, The 14th anniversary of DACA represents more than progress — it highlights just how much is at risk. Its future has never been more uncertain. But home is here, and we're not going anywhere. **[That's why I'm asking: will you contribute $14 — one dollar for every year DACA has been in place — to support United We Dream? Every donation helps power the organizing, advocacy, and rapid response work needed to defend our communities and win a pathway to citizenship.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeRSb6UyzukpYsZgexseLha1n3hAbO_p8Utnp75qrFZNpZ-7otCwJdltNocNxgmWqnTRWYRrIz_cv7AqoLQY0cAcf_3LvJTymx918JJGtrBviUNnvItF_gNnqKnI2Ow9uuAbkdKOs1XAzaL6e-ebMH6bNW4zK5lXjcOOUAE_NfV6xu1ouWrJaPliuawS2rX57h0XYAhZwJa6b9vPDfuD0nptfQQ1ahaUU1Ia8TKcfl9Q8b5nPKBz2j0inwNXSipBLMsnOVdQBRRb5-F3rOyz5edw2iZ3gy1lxLB-vDquVbgCVcHpbc26DxTHRPsiMAh5koNInZ-NQPN-j6Cc-9sX-IGrQZ7CSLnLAy9A1mLIIcRrB8FwSH0MmqYEm1BDpMLWhQImBRX1q-FpUw5EHc6YKfHJMUHYZ_ubqPPNev6Z5508hZSwS9AqPvZF72yoI491RHV3HWK4vjXzqhFO-mBfAxlhMH4QgBwhN-oDvn_bxl1xw/4rv/0p4eQA2TQCKZ_DyomaR6QQ/h0/h001.TQMzSrhGpmk0N3a2bfITzTtvvsP0QjTSuhM0Uo2qiu4)** The situation is urgent. A broad effort to strip protections from millions of immigrants — including people with TPS, refugee status, and asylum protections — has put our coworkers, classmates, neighbors, and loved ones in danger of being detained and deported. **Still, we're not backing down. Instead, we're turning individual actions into collective power.** Throughout June, 15 letter-writing events brought people together from coast to coast — from Texas and Florida to Michigan — turning community action into a powerful call for change.
* In Texas, people of faith wrote more than 70 letters to their Members of Congress and assembled 50 community protection packets to help inform and support their neighbors.
* In Florida, two brothers hosted gatherings with friends and hand-delivered their letters to their Members of Congress.
* In Michigan, neighbors gathered for an afternoon of writing letters, sharing snacks, and growing our power.

We **delivered 62,000 letters** — in person, at district offices, by mail, and via email — calling on Congress to support a pathway to citizenship and real solutions like the Dream Act and the Dream and Promise Act. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeRSb6UyzukpYsZgexseLha1n3hAbO_p8Utnp75qrFZNpZ-7otCwJdltNocNxgmWqnTRWYRrIz_cv7AqoLQY0cAXbGG7mlBuLTy0VvxvmGgoBk5zvPK4pJkXpKlUuaQki6H-bpa70CwsO4uFfffWG24QrdR0Yee_2TIoRj1JUberB1Jab_ZPM0DcY5_V1GRN6dV4KMSXaysuGjInJXpeWp4VE0EcSa1CMNsnvUi9-wnXO8oT1C7ejWcNwoEeKYFKIfOqbZg_CLTf3TMagyOngIv_EPgoNTzmzMT40TWcT8ym0LJam30RGZ3e1eOkP7YEznhdMWi4L2sQ4JtO709C2c0jG5eAzEpsLA3lneIH6AvHznczI0a4Z1x17CUtqb1LNVZTR8HUXn0qAwDPwT7uEh1raX9Sw9zicgkIYpF6Mj6P1pqPdDHnwXst5jerPf2ozDUcmED9YHAX1PbSPbFRXNFg/4rv/0p4eQA2TQCKZ_DyomaR6QQ/h1/h001.y5vLJh1dl0vxPwY29HFKLseNK2kj_PqB026V6hRXSkw) On June 15 — the 14th anniversary of DACA — UWD members from across the nation rallied at the Capitol. The Home is Here mobilization brought together immigrant youth, directly impacted families, faith leaders, educators, healthcare workers, labor allies, small business owners, and cross-movement partners to demand a pathway to citizenship. Hundreds of young people visited the offices of their Members of Congress to deliver their call for citizenship. For some, this was their first time making a lobby visit. In Chicago and Houston, neighbors held press events with elected officials to make clear why our communities need citizenship now. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeRSb6UyzukpYsZgexseLha1n3hAbO_p8Utnp75qrFZNpZ-7otCwJdltNocNxgmWqnTRWYRrIz_cv7AqoLQY0cAYXSNDSRXhrosybU75EA-xCq6S0sBJCRifWyd_xr_u2BlX8PMRgrUo7duvVd8co4TPO2-KsfnSDX6VxSAYzTj5wu4yTiKOC8ps38sWfRJrfdSKlKDpp-kRjrkdGgaXBxGNobkDVvMSbA5Hocmw1-v_BGujPGtyhm16-IzAE729ph1vD2I3pdixJnjq0feVaxsGRXD9o8QY5WYV3eJKyM04ZLzRNqHjdJQCujO35-1VqYqfE9uXFOU8NFy5WDjjRhlQvcBS6n4e3dvp2hZs2pKUZ9V3DuyLlFD8sLkwUOiRIkw_Cu1pOJJjAxsgrSusIRxqeNFOuGp_WAtNBZBHOWvbsoP7cR_JgSagA84RTHQ1N3IAfCRZINGntnJumZTJKYuA/4rv/0p4eQA2TQCKZ_DyomaR6QQ/h2/h001.ssX4DAMvxRVs6DmG6P04zy_-bQKZvbgbr2d2bSgbfew) Fourteen years ago, through organizing, persistence, and collective action, immigrant youth protected our communities and helped build a stronger future for everyone. **There's no denying the power we hold when we stand united.** We refuse to let DACA protections disappear, and we refuse to let our communities lose their status and security. **[United We Dream remains on the front lines — mobilizing, advocating, and working toward a future where everyone can thrive and where citizenship is finally within reach. clean_body: 14 years of DACA, and its protections have never been under greater threat. Chip in to UWD today. | | | Peter, The 14th anniversary of DACA represents more than progress — it highlights just how much is at risk. Its future has never been more uncertain. But home is here, and we're not going anywhere. The situation is urgent. A broad effort to strip protections from millions of immigrants — including people with TPS, refugee status, and asylum protections — has put our coworkers, classmates, neighbors, and loved ones in danger of being detained and deported. Still, we're not backing down. Instead, we're turning individual actions into collective power. Throughout June, 15 letter-writing events brought people together from coast to coast — from Texas and Florida to Michigan — turning community action into a powerful call for change. In Texas, people of faith wrote more than 70 letters to their Members of Congress and assembled 50 community protection packets to help inform and support their neighbors. In Florida, two brothers hosted gatherings with friends and hand-delivered their letters to their Members of Congress. In Michigan, neighbors gathered for an afternoon of writing letters, sharing snacks, and growing our power. We delivered 62,000 letters — in person, at district offices, by mail, and via email — calling on Congress to support a pathway to citizenship and real solutions like the Dream Act and the Dream and Promise Act. On June 15 — the 14th anniversary of DACA — UWD members from across the nation rallied at the Capitol. The Home is Here mobilization brought together immigrant youth, directly impacted families, faith leaders, educators, healthcare workers, labor allies, small business owners, and cross-movement partners to demand a pathway to citizenship. Hundreds of young people visited the offices of their Members of Congress to deliver their call for citizenship. For some, this was their first time making a lobby visit. In Chicago and Houston, neighbors held press events with elected officials to make clear why our communities need citizenship now. Fourteen years ago, through organizing, persistence, and collective action, immigrant youth protected our communities and helped build a stronger future for everyone. There's no denying the power we hold when we stand united. We refuse to let DACA protections disappear, and we refuse to let our communities lose their status and security. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | Thank you, Nico, United We Dream Follow us on: | | | | |

body:
| |
---
Hi friend, It's Kalliana, Sue's campaign manager. A few days ago, Sue told you about our June 30 public filing deadline and our goal of raising another $25,000 before the books close at midnight on Tuesday. I'm emailing because we're running out of time to hit that goal, and I’m really hoping you are someone we can count on to help us reach it. [**Can you chip in right now to help us close the gap before June 30?**](https://sue4ri.com/l/ovGeRKulzmuv) Close to every hour, I refresh our fundraising reports, update our projections, and compare where we are to where we need to be. And right now, the reality is this: **While we are confident we have the**** _most donors of any candidate,_****we’re still running behind our competition in dollars in the bank.** And if we want a true progressive representing Rhode Island as LG, we need to step up our game this week, or we may never catch up. Over the next few weeks, every campaign in this race is making decisions that will shape the rest of the primary.
---
**_How much mail can we send?_** **_How many voters can we reach online?_** **_How aggressively can we spend to introduce Sue to people who haven't heard her story yet?_**
---
And unlike our opponents, we don't have a handful of wealthy donors waiting in the wings to write enormous checks if we come up short.
---
| |
Thousands of grassroots supporters are giving what they can because they believe Rhode Island deserves a Lieutenant Governor like Sue, who will fight for working people.
[](https://sue4ri.com/l/BZB5tWP5UV44)
That's our strength, and we could not be prouder.

But it's also why these final days of the quarter matter so much.

**[Every dollar we raise before June 30 gives us more flexibility, more opportunities to communicate with voters, and more confidence as we head into the final stretch of this race. Can you help us finish strong and raise the final dollars we need before our public filing deadline?](https://sue4ri.com/l/DPPb7FPyZh0b)** If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | [ **DONATE $25** ](https://sue4ri.com/l/sCs1EFVn7sbo)

Thank you for being part of this. — Kalliana

name: David Hogg
subject: This has the establishment panicking
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Our blueprint is working — we need your support before June 30th to keep up our momentum.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260628-1&t=1&akid=3657%2E587540%2E7uTOjD)
Peter,
I have to say it: we’re absolutely _crushing it_ this cycle. 21 wins, 42 endorsements and counting. But I am worried about whether we can keep this momentum going through November — I will get to that in a second, though.
We just had a big night in New York — our candidates **Claire Valdez** and **Aber Kawas** both defeated their establishment-backed opponents by over 20 percent!!
In California, **Randy Villegas** went up against a candidate backed by the DCCC and $2.8 million from AIPAC-affiliated groups. But we advised his campaign daily and spent almost $400,000 getting his message out to voters, and he won his primary. He’s headed to a competitive general election against Republican David Valadao, and his race is one that will decide who controls the House. And **Mai Vang** took on a 45-year+ political dynasty and won, even in the face of hundreds of thousands from defense contractors, AIPAC and her 81 year old billionaire opponent loaning herself $1 million.
From Georgia and Texas to Pennsylvania and Illinois, we’re building a bench of bold young leaders in state legislatures and in Congress to fight for working people.
But here is why I am worried — while we have had many hard fought wins against the establishment and corporations, we are doing two challenging but necessary things at the same time. We are shaking up the Democratic party by challenging the asleep at the wheel Democrats who caused us to lose not once but TWICE against Trump. We’re also fighting tooth and nail to break Republican majorities in state legislatures and Congress across the country.
We need your help to make sure we can finish the primary season strong to offer voters new leaders instead of new talking points and ensure Democrats have the best chance possible to beat Republicans in November.
We’re flipping critical swing districts, taking down special interest money on their own turf, and proving that working class politics and grassroots momentum is the way forward.
**[Pitch in $5 now to help us reach our $115,000 goal before June 30 and keep up our momentum to finish primary season strong and flip seats this November.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260628_1_momentum.QHBVWH&refcode=em20260628-3657&amount=5&t=2&akid=3657%2E587540%2E7uTOjD)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260628_1_momentum.QHBVWH&amount=5&refcode=em20260628-3657&t=3&akid=3657%2E587540%2E7uTOjD)**
Every single one of these wins tells the same story: when you back the _best_ candidates with a real plan for the way forward and refuse to take a single dime from anyone trying to buy their way into our politics — **_we win**_.
That’s our model for winning, and it works. All of it is made possible by this people-powered movement. Supporters like you, stepping up to fuel our work so we can find fearless young leaders early, back them with real resources, and support them from launch day all the way to victory.
We’ve still got more ground to cover before this quarter closes out. **This is the season when campaigns build the strength they need to win, or come up short — so I mean it when I say it really matters.** We need you with us to reach our goal.
**[Will you make a $5 contribution today to help Leaders We Deserve hit our $115,000 goal by June 30 and power this important work?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260628_1_momentum.QHBVWH&refcode=em20260628-3657&amount=5&t=4&akid=3657%2E587540%2E7uTOjD)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

When you hear a politician flexing their knowledge on their constituents, they usually resort to geography. _" From X Street to Y Avenue, I know them!"_
**But what do you know ABOUT them?**
Representation means showing up for everyone, and really knowing your community. That's why I spent time at Rutherford Pride & Davidson County, standing alongside volunteers, community members, and neighbors from every walk of life!
Politics in Tennessee, and frankly across America too often, tells certain communities they don't belong in the conversation. I disagree. "Hometowns Over Headlines" means exactly what it sounds like:**every hometown, every neighbor, every Tennessean deserves a representative who will actually listen.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/813ece62-8fb9-4819-b391-4cfeb9d19516?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

The energy at events like this is incredible. Young volunteers giving up their weekend, longtime residents stopping by the booth, and genuine conversations about what people need from their next representative. As we wrap up Pride Month, I've come to realize that not many Representatives are showing up like this, _**and it isn 't a coincidence: **_Campaigns like this don't run on corporate PAC money. They run on people like you, amazing people like the ones showing up for each other here! **This campaign isn 't bought out by the Big Corporations that try to dictate the agenda, and it's why we are proud to support every member of our communities!**

Hi Peter, it's Carina -- Randy’s wife.

Before Randy was ever a candidate for Congress, he was my high school sweetheart. We've grown up together, built our family here, and celebrated life's biggest blessings, and we've carried some of its hardest burdens here. The Central Valley isn't just where we live - it's home. It's where our parents worked long hours to build a better life and where our hearts have always been.

That's why this campaign has meant so much to us.

I've had a front row seat to the man he is when no one is watching. I've seen him stay up late worrying about families who can't afford groceries. I've watched him spend weekends canvassing neighborhoods in the central valley heat because he believes every person deserves to be heard. I’ve seen him pour every ounce of himself into fighting for a community that has given us so much. That’s who Randy is.

So, when the results came in on primary night, I wasn’t just proud because he won. I was inspired because, after everything they threw at us -- the millions in attack ads, the establishment lining up against him, our campaign spending down to zero -- **we won and our community chose hope.**

But I also know Randy well enough to know he wasn't thinking about himself that night. He was thinking about the farmworkers who feed the country. The nurses who showed up to rallies after working all day. The volunteers who knocked doors because they believed their voice mattered. The families who donated $5, $10, $25 because they believed in Randy.

**Now we’re facing the general election. And our first big test is already here — the June 30th FEC deadline. The only way we can keep going is with people like you.**

We've grown up together, built our family here, and celebrated life's biggest blessings, and we've carried some of its hardest burdens here. The Central Valley isn't just where we live - it's home. It's where our parents worked long hours to build a better life and where our hearts have always been. That's why this campaign has meant so much to us. I've had a front row seat to the man he is when no one is watching. I've seen him stay up late worrying about families who can't afford groceries. I've watched him spend weekends canvassing neighborhoods in the central valley heat because he believes every person deserves to be heard. I’ve seen him pour every ounce of himself into fighting for a community that has given us so much. That’s who Randy is. So, when the results came in on primary night, I wasn’t just proud because he won. I was inspired because, after everything they threw at us -- the millions in attack ads, the establishment lining up against him, our campaign spending down to zero -- we won and our community chose hope. subject: Trump’s plan to cut Social Security
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA

# [](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51612?refcode=jtk575-fr-nd-header&t=1&akid=10836%2E434096%2ErT7Q0S)
| | |

Derek, Trump has already closed Social Security offices, cut staff, and made it harder for seniors to get help over the phone.
**Now, it’s just been reported that Trump and Republicans plan to cut Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid next year.**
Their goal is simple: break Social Security, run it dry, and sell it for scrap.
Not on my watch. I reintroduced the **Billionaires Income Tax Act** to make the ultrawealthy pay their fair share in taxes.
That’s money we can use to keep our promise to seniors and protect Social Security for the next generation.
Because here's the deal: Working Pennsylvanians are facing high and rising prices while the ultrawealthy and megacorporations game the system to pay next to nothing in taxes. This bill is about basic fairness – if you have billions, you shouldn’t pay less in taxes than your secretary.
This is just one of the ways I’m standing up to these Social Security cuts – but I can’t keep up the pressure alone. I need your help to call out Trump’s schemes and spread the word.
**[So my team and I are racing to hit our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline on Tuesday at midnight to sound the alarm. Can you chip in $5 right now to help us hit our $60,000 goal and tell Trump to keep his HANDS OFF Social Security? 🙏](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/53627?t=2&akid=10836%2E434096%2ErT7Q0S)**

**The paperwork has been filed, and I’m running for re-election to continue representing Delaware in the House of Representatives.**

My first term in Congress has been eventful to say the least. Elon Musk’s DOGE ransacked the federal government, Republicans slashed funding for Medicaid, food assistance, and other critical programs working families rely on, and Donald Trump started a reckless, illegal war that has caused even more pain for Americans as gas prices rose in response.

But every step of the way, I’ve been proud to stand up and fight for what’s right for Delaware. Now, this November, we have a chance to take back the majority and start passing an agenda that will put working families first for a change.

When I was first elected last year, I said that**I believe small states can do big things** — and there is no limit to what we can accomplish when we work together to make people’s lives better. That holds true now more than ever.

If we’re going to flip the House in this year’s midterms so that we can hold this administration accountable and pass a budget that centers the needs of regular Delawareans over Trump and his billionaire allies, **it has to start by keeping this seat blue.**

Republicans would love nothing more than to flip Delaware red, and I’m going to do everything I can to make sure that doesn’t happen. That’s why I just finished visiting all 57 of Delaware’s municipalities in just 57 hours — to talk to our neighbors across the state and remind them why they trusted me to represent them in Congress: to deliver lower costs, expand access to healthcare, and protect our fundamental rights.

body:
Here’s where you come in.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260628_2.-Y30kP&refcode=em20260628-2&t=1&akid=7449%2E582294%2EniuGWk)
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[split a donation between my campaign and Chris Pappas to help us reach our critical $3,000,000 goal before the end-of-quarter FEC deadline.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260628_2.-Y30kP&refcode=em20260628-2&t=2&akid=7449%2E582294%2EniuGWk)** But first, let me explain why your support is so important...and what could happen without it.
Growing up in Mansfield, Ohio, my community was made up of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. I’ve devoted my career to fighting for hardworking Ohio families as corrupt politicians, lobbyists, and billionaires cut them out of the deal.
Right now, politicians in Washington are doing everything but putting working people first. They’re only looking out for their billionaire donors and corporate allies. _It’s unacceptable._
**I know what it takes to beat the odds and win, because I’ve done it before.**
But with dark-money super PACs pouring in MILLIONS to defeat me and polls showing this race neck and neck, _I need unprecedented grassroots support from people like you to do it again._
**[That’s where you come in. I'm counting on you to keep powering this campaign forward so we can flip Ohio’s Senate seat – and that won't happen unless we raise $3,000,000 before the crucial FEC deadline. So please, will you split $5 or whatever you can afford? Sherrod Brown

name: Andrew Friedson
subject: Thank you, Montgomery County
body:
I could not be prouder of the campaign we ran, or more honored to stand with you in the fight for the future of our county.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134199885/630437820/-1573688718?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjN2QwOGFhNS0xODczLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eI0VeWqYv7cHqFu0KRYXVmyRPVURrcfeqxSR5wBB2K4=&emci=e55b2e85-1373-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=c7d08aa5-1873-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=21244937)
---
| Peter,

After allowing two additional days to count the outstanding mail-in ballots to respect the process and ensure every voice is heard, it has become clear that there are not enough remaining votes to change the outcome of this election.

I have spoken with Will to congratulate him on his successful campaign, and offered him my support as our Democratic nominee. We are all deeply invested in our County’s success, and that is all I have ever wanted for the only place I have ever called home: a community that is affordable, economically competitive, and guided by a government that truly works for the people it serves.

When we launched this campaign, we set out with a clear, urgent vision: to build a Montgomery County that is truly affordable, accessible, and full of opportunity for everyone who calls it home.

We began as clear underdogs, running against candidates with better countywide name recognition. Yet, we proved the naysayers wrong: showing that a district Councilmember could build a broad, deep coalition and mount a highly competitive, countywide Executive campaign. Alongside firefighters, retired teachers, housing advocates, police officers, nonprofit leaders, elected officials from every level of government, and residents from across the county, we shared an inclusive, future-focused vision that resonated across Montgomery County.

While we have come up a little short, my belief in Montgomery County remains unshaken, and the work to make Montgomery County more affordable and economically competitive continues. That has been my focus since I first ran for County Council eight years ago, and it will always be my North Star. I am incredibly proud that, together on this campaign, we forced a desperately needed conversation about affordability, focused on lowering costs and creating jobs. Our message became the central theme of the entire public conversation, not just for our campaign, but for every campaign. This must remain the relentless focus of the next County Executive and County Council, and because of our collective work, I believe it will be.

I could not be prouder of the campaign we ran, or more honored to stand with you in the fight for the future of our county. Though our beloved county faces unprecedented challenges, I continue to believe our potential far outweighs our problems, and it will take all of us working together to solve them.

To my wife, Demi, who brought our perfect baby into this world in the middle of the campaign and handled it all with extraordinary grace and understanding; to our daughter, Joelle, who grounds me and reminds me every day of what is at stake; and to our parents and families who’ve surrounded us with unending love and support, thank you for making all this possible.

To the hundreds of volunteers and thousands of supporters who joined us on this journey, you have my profound gratitude for your unwavering support. I’ve been deeply humbled and honored to embark on this journey with you at a defining moment for our county, and during a time of such amazing changes for my own family.

I am humbled; I am grateful; I am hopeful.

With deepest appreciation and gratitude,

I've studied elections for 50 years
This is a warning sign. You need to take this seriously

| | | | _**FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH**_
---
Patriot, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because **what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation**.

_Let me give you the facts._

A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history.

Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming.

**The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections.** It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you.

The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct.

Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage.

**_I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back._**

In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won.

**Ken Paxton can win this race.** President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that.

[**I am asking you today, as someone who has spent five decades fighting for this country and this party, to make an urgent contribution to Ken Paxton's campaign. Give $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can right now.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=d56d11b85a684078a8720cbcd1b32fd9&_e=0DR4EutWg_pwXQHUB9pRo9MA0yNjx6m6yRpGie6kfr6L_qbNQ_8qG9GZ-04uxUPpvyc-f98oMIqCd4zRap-Pm7ajeYGDB5fZURTN6vz90tkpPQA2glkBevEnvy-0BGkACaM-eZTae3Z14dnGAg0T0a8jjXrJZGJE420WbWbZZrObeashr69DEolpdUifL95JEr0K-XBIAFho8KEODLjzEc42dgpOWwgDMGQZndDN5_xGEMb_uZfijKVrNXTE1pbxxIODCtouZpNyzVzp-7Wu7kd1zl6kTI7hezxScBTcPlcoGfn2MBJq5ku4WNySj0irDgQE4yRUqSA6RlxeVLMybyHFOHqKWPPoyo4rfqHBaHXjElmTSzAwjA6_5l4I-kjfc_tHvMkdbgNCgBTUuYN-CSudMpJiEDVN8cn-ZZ_HjVsrCD5cXifclAtQqC1Y09-ww02m_Dc0ElOocIl-_lv3F3zplyPljXp1J1NbdxvfiCB7hjK0m_8dRGqgm4CzXUisTim_ZbCkMbylgxhZbwJHXUJtx_u5dl-jjVrjkj0AH6reu2iKWazfr5CyS7jM5pqqN46_Hmrc9ODs9bMtIo_8By4mj_R6IDaNwJNV4G6hQm8Z8zopVTk1cGV-BINYu29hq8HP-BX4jrClAlRFV6gwRkUZWMc-8J8iBTM3o0fNBG6wyUcYkhabULRdLwOPePrvuTZZ8cNgKcu1KLV5dAyu4uEbC4v26IM4p-PhnbsF8oVw-NjTI9m3dUjJHrn-j_Ux-o7ryXuocyOre2W_pNQVAc0tk9OJzVm3KcdwSKjZK_hsjTK7e1KcqMiANqPHDq-v5W7Kt0RuxYlUZlT1r_Y5_eL0Qyka1xk6je2Wf6jnqnHTLnfqpWFEj5aTURcortjRxBQYkVM1Y2YG4fXEk28xVxjBCEs0bNZmfVeaKkJ5fFbS6zIwWrkudcm6kjOmkErPN7MeGfR-xwjO2YyIc1vIe9pI2PxImH0WfQ0ody9VLRs%3D)

clean_body: I've studied elections for 50 years This is a warning sign. You need to take this seriously | | | | FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH Patriot, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation. Let me give you the facts. A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history. Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming. The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections. It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you. The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct. Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage. I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back. In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won. Ken Paxton can win this race. President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that. Texas is not going to flip because the Democrats got lucky. It will only flip if we let them. Do not let them flip Texas! Thanks, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House P.S. | | | Paid for by Ken Paxton for Senate | | PO BOX 3476 MCKINNEY, TX 75070 | | |

That's why I'm running.

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Team
The Constitution places the authority to run elections squarely with the states and Congress – NOT with the federal government.
But now, the President has issued another executive order imposing sweeping new federal control over election administration.
Make no mistake, Team, this is yet another unlawful attempt by this MAGA administration to sow confusion and distrust ahead of the fall midterm elections.
We're doing everything in our power to fight back and protect the right to vote , including:
➜ Registering eligible voters
➜ Putting election information directly in the hands of voters
➜ Combating election misinformation
➜ Advocating at every level to keep our elections truly free and fair
Team, it will take massive resources to stand up to this new executive order in time to make a difference before the midterm elections. We need your help ASAP: Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can afford right now? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062826_2&amount=35]

name: Stacy Garrity
subject: FWD: Shameful
body:
We all know that Josh Shapiro is a petty, little man. But Josh Shapiro’s latest stunt is shameful.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/jNlkzwnUA6F?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Peter,
We all know that Josh Shapiro is a petty, little man. But Josh Shapiro’s latest stunt is shameful.
Pennsylvania is the Keystone State of our nation. Our revolution was sparked in Philadelphia. The American experiment was preserved on the fields of Gettysburg. And the industrial revolution that changed the course of human history was born in our Commonwealth.
But because Josh Shapiro put his political ambition ahead of sharing a moment of unity, **Pennsylvania will not be a part of celebrating America 250 at the Great American State Fair.**
America’s 250th birthday is about celebrating all that America is and all that we are! The United States has freed more people from tyranny and created more economic opportunity than any nation in history. That’s why people from around the globe, regardless of race, gender, or creed choose to come to our shores to achieve the American Dream. America is the shining city on the hill!
Yet Josh Shapiro decided to take this moment of unity and create a moment of division, all in the name of scoring cheap political points.
I served our nation in uniform for 30 years, where I defended our freedoms, our values, and our people. I didn’t serve a Republican America or a Democrat America. I served the United States of America. And I am proud to celebrate our nation’s birthday with every Pennsylvanian, regardless of political affiliation.
I hope you will join me this week in celebrating all that America has given the World and all the progress we will spark over the next 250 years.
God Bless,

body:
secure.actblue.com/donate/2026-rg-em [secure.actblue.com/donate/2026-rg-em]
Donald Trump promised to "beautify" the Reflecting Pool.
Instead, taxpayers got a $14 million mess:
❌ The project's cost ballooned from an estimated $2 million to more than $14 million.
❌ The paint is already peeling.
❌ The water turned green with algae.
❌ The entire thing has had to be fenced off and drained again.
And now we're learning that the contractors responsible received no-bid contracts despite having little or no federal experience.
That's why I launched an Oversight Committee investigation this week:
secure.actblue.com/donate/2026-rg-em [secure.actblue.com/donate/2026-rg-em]
The American people deserve to know why politically connected contractors were handed millions of taxpayer dollars for a project that appears to have failed almost immediately.
They deserve to know who approved these contracts, how costs exploded by more than $12 million, and whether cronyism determined who got the job.
This isn't just about a reflecting pool. It's about a pattern.
We've seen it with sweetheart contracts. We've seen it with the Epstein cover-up. We've seen it with this administration rewarding loyalists while ordinary Americans struggle to pay their bills.
While families worry about the cost of groceries, rent, and health care, Donald Trump is wasting millions of taxpayer dollars on vanity projects that are literally starting to fall apart.
That's unacceptable. And as the lead Democrat on the House Oversight Committee, I'm going to keep demanding answers. But I can't do it alone. Will you chip in today to help power our fight for accountability and oversight? [secure.actblue.com/donate/2026-rg-em]

Dear Friend of Truth,Imagine watching your daughter compete in a high school girls wrestling tournament.She’s prepared, she’s excited, she’s strong... but then, during a match, you suddenly see her face change.She looks at you frantically and mouths something. _She’s desperately trying to tell you that she’s being sexually assaulted by her opponent._ She throws the match just to make it stop. She’s no stranger to the physicality of her sport ... but nothing like this has ever happened to her before.**And then you learn another troubling reality: Her opponent was a biological male who identifies as a girl.**[ PROTECT FEMALE ATHLETES ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/OwFy962cbGlrVT2eLH7X2f7wZCRIkYlOGmkCOruMFNwUUuHPXQnF9D%2FWIhux%0AezoZOixgdEIQtjHKXDoz0JcEpaelvpY9z8qI9ZHFsnKthuUuFmtzFsyW%2BzS9%0Ah5ixUTYX4eKHpeh6%2FcrmkEB9103NqRw%2BxSBh5Hu%2BajUmf0OXBsqMgRCakWhp%0AT26urqjVsQSWQg3ZQ4Hk58aTOAiM3ohTHw%3D%3D%0A/ddf3b7e276680f08)This is Kallie Keeler’s story. Without her knowledge, she was pitted against a male athlete from another school during a girls high school wrestling tournament. While they were wrestling, her opponent sexually assaulted her. She allowed herself to be pinned just so the match would end.Kallie and her mom immediately reported the incident to her coach, but school administrators didn’t bring in law enforcement for nearly two months—and then, only after an independent journalist reached out for comment.We can never allow this kind of atrocity to happen to another girl. Ever.**But as long as our laws allow female athletes to unknowingly compete against biological males, our sisters, our daughters, and our granddaughters are at risk.** Alliance Defending Freedom has filed Kallie’s case and will represent her in court at no cost to her family.But we can only fight for clients like Kallie through the support of generous people like you.**Will you give today to protect fairness and safety in women’s sports across the nation?**[ DONATE NOW ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/Bd8InM8CFOBBpEHIlCFv17xeuGNQxPk9QlcFgQ%2BfhcLnKXb9MNyItedVbrdY%0AV8jTpTeIM2pC6%2BZc4plhwIswePehmkslKhuFMtx12xKrJYPWPtLt%2F1oNWZzD%0AEchy5WnpAEp34NpX5z0npPJn7PQrJzxYA%2ByOsTfbOUB5No0nTbUDdTtcZ6Un%0Ab1O9MxontNVquM414SfrTVjD0CDY3NFWIQ%3D%3D%0A/75db89d3a6301862)Your tax-deductible support helps ADF take on critical cases like Kallie’s—defending women and girls from unfair competition and protecting them from harm in sports.Thank you for standing with us to do what’s right. Sincerely,

This Saturday, the country they built turns 250--and we're marking the anniversary in a moment those founders would recognize cold: a government run by people who treat the Constitution as an obstacle, a press that keeps sanding the edges off authoritarianism until it sounds like a personnel dispute, and a predator class that buys the politics it wants and sends the rest of us the bill.

That is exactly why Blue Amp exists.
**We name them.**
We refuse the both‐sides fog.
We do the work the cable networks won't.

June 29, 2026
If anyone believes that the Democratic Party is not the party of socialism, I will gladly send you the title to the Brooklyn Bridge if you send me a check for $1,000.
Socialists are on [a roll](https://substack.com/redirect/f35790c7-5a81-4ca6-88e8-c9ca3fb00ada?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Mamdani is the mayor of New York. Katie Wilson runs Seattle. Graham Platner is the US Senate nominee in Maine. The new mayor of Washington D. C. will be Janeese Lewis George. All, by their own admission, are socialists. And socialists just obliterated more traditional Democrats in the New York City primaries.
But while the term socialist is thrown around in politics, it is worth reviewing its definition. According to Wikipedia, socialism is:

"An economic and political philosophy advocating for collective or governmental ownership and administration of the means of production and distribution of goods."
And the recently elected socialists are not only fulfilling this definition but taking it a step further stating that the United States was built by racism, greed and intolerance. A recent poll showed that only 29% of Democrats were proud to be Americans, as opposed to 90% of Republicans.
The keffiyeh-wearing Avila Chevalier, the primary winner for New York's 13th Congressional District, stated the United State is a "f**king disgrace" and believes in open borders, the abolishment of prisons and that illegal immigrants who commit violent crimes should not be deported. She stated, "we are Westerners fighting for the total eradication of Western civilization. We stand in full solidarity with every movement for liberation in the Global South. Our Intifada is an international one."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f3d3efc1-0312-4294-b79f-36d8f186c5cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Democratic Congressional Nominee Avila Chevalier
Claire Valdez, the primary winner for New York's 7th Congressional District, believes that ICE (immigration and Customs Enforcement) and the TSA (Transportation Security Administration) should be abolished.

Socialism has never worked in human history and countries that become socialist can only remain socialist by banning further elections while confiscating guns so that the military can murder those who rebel.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1a904d99-b0a5-410c-997c-1c4cf4694872?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And socialists love to blame someone and often they are the Jews. Many people know that Hitler was a Nazi but do not know that Nazi is the abbreviation for National-sozialistische, which translates into English to National Socialist. The Nazis [confiscated private property](https://substack.com/redirect/4d3c4e26-a868-4a0e-9f5a-206b2e757152?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and took over private companies.
Mamdani's wife, Rama Duwaji, liked multiple Instagram posts [supporting](https://substack.com/redirect/ed58728f-2e6c-451d-9ffa-b653c9efdc5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the October 7 Hamas attack on Israel in which many Jews were raped and killed. Mamdani himself characterized the pro-Israeli fund-raising group AIPAC (American Israel Public Affairs Committee) as "monsters."
Claire Valdez believes that Hamas' attack on Israel was justified.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e0bde1db-2f48-4791-a118-5416dcc132ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Democratic Congression Nominee Claire Valdez (on the right with the darker glasses)
Naive Republicans are looking at these socialist victories with pleasure under the fallacious assumption that socialists can't win nationally. Nothing could be further from the truth. Some polls had the Vermont socialist Senator Bernie Sanders consistently ahead of Donald Trump in the 2016 presidential race.
And even when so-call moderate Democrats win, they kowtow to their socialist base. President Biden opened our borders allowing 10,000,000 illegal immigrants to enter the country. President Trump's attempts to deport them have been met with violence against ICE in Democratic strongholds such as Minnesota. The state's governor, former Democratic vice-presidential nominee Tim Walz, not only did nothing to stop this thuggery, but supported the violent ICE protestors while Minnesota's Attorney General, Keith Ellison, refused to charge them.
Of course, the Democrats will now do what they do best - lie. They will tell the American public that the socialists are just a few crazy outliers and that they are sensible.
Former chairman of the Democratic National Committee, Jaime Harrison stated.
"I say this with no ill will or animosity: if you hate the Democratic Party, then please don't run for our nomination. Don't use our resources. Don't rely on our volunteers. Don't use our infrastructure. Don't ask Democrats to invest their time, money, and energy in your campaign."
And you will see other Democrats such as Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, Jim Himes and Senator Chris Murphy repeat Harrison's lie.

But remember, that Schumer and Democratic Presidential nominee Kamala Harris openly said they would stack the Supreme Court if they had won the Senate and the White House in 2024. And if the Democrats win the White House and Senate in 2028, that is exactly what they will do. Their socialist base will demand it.
And that will truly be the end of our democracy as the newly minted liberal judges will abolish the Second Amendment (confiscate guns), abolish the Electoral College and allow fraudulent elections.
The United States is now hosting the 23rd FIFA World Cup Men's Soccer Championship and the Europeans visiting have been amazed how [wonderful, prosperous and friendly Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/48c9afee-fd69-4ed7-baca-8c6244a8246f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are. Many don't want to leave. But what these Europeans are saying is that the liberal media in Europe, just like our liberal media in the United States, has told them that our country is full of bigoted, impoverished Trump-loving losers. And then they come here an discover it is only the liberals - such celebrities as Rosie O'Donnell, Robert De Niro and CNN pundits - who hate the country.

But if the Democrats return to power, our freedom and prosperity will come to an abrupt end.

But with our deadline just two days away, I want to explain _why_ this deadline is so important.
